transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I, uh... I hope I'm not wasting your time today. 

I came in because... well, it sounds a little silly when I say it out loud, and I really don't want you to think I'm a complainer or causing trouble. But I've been having a hard time at my apartment building lately. I just... I know the people living around me are watching my comings and goings. And I'm pretty sure they've been slipping notes about me to the management office. 

Everybody keeps telling me I'm wrong, that they're just regular building notices they tape on the doors, but... well, I just wanted to come in and get checked out, to make sure I'm doing the right thing. I hope it's okay that I came to talk to you about it?

Can you tell me more about your belief that the people in your building are watching you and leaving notes? Have you had these thoughts even when you were feeling emotionally well, or do they mostly happen when you're feeling particularly down or stressed?

Well, I... I hope I'm explaining this right, doctor. I really don't want to sound like I'm just making a fuss or acting crazy. But, um... to answer your question, it's not just when I'm feeling really down. 

Like, there was a spell a little while back, maybe for several weeks, where I was actually doing a bit better. I was, you know, eating a little more normally and I wasn't waking up feeling so... so heavy and hopeless every single morning. I was trying really hard to keep a good attitude, I promise I was. 

But even then, when my mood was actually pretty decent... I still knew they were watching my door. I could still tell they were keeping tabs on my comings and goings and reporting on me to the office. 

I'm sorry, I know saying that probably sounds strange. Does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so I don't waste your time.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that others around you don't seem to hear, or experienced any unusual sensations that you felt were not explained by normal circumstances?

Oh, no, doctor. I... well, I promise I don't hear anything like that. I know sometimes people who come to clinics like this might hear voices, but I don't, I swear. 

Just the regular noises in the building, you know, like the pipes clanking or people walking out in the halls. But no voices or... or strange feelings that aren't supposed to be there. I try really hard to keep my head on straight, I really do. 

I hope that's a good thing? I mean, I hope that's the right answer for you. I'm just trying to be as honest as I can so I'm not making your job harder. Did I explain that okay?
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or ideas that others might not share or understand, aside from what you've told me about your neighbors?

No, doctor, I... I don't think so. I really try to be level-headed about most things. I mean, I know I get a little worked up about the apartment building, but that's really the only thing. 

I promise I don't have any other strange ideas or anything like that. I just try to mind my own business and keep out of everyone's way. I hope that's what you were asking? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. I'm not trying to hide anything, I swear. Is that... is that okay?
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something strongly that turned out not to be true, even though others tried to convince you otherwise?

Well, I... I guess that kind of brings us back to the apartment building, doctor. I hope you don't mind me bringing it up again. I just want to make sure I'm answering you right. 

See, I know everybody keeps telling me that the papers they leave on the doors are just regular notices... you know, like building maintenance or whatever. But... well, I came in today because I just know they're watching my comings and goings. I know they're slipping notes about me to the office. 

I've tried to listen when people tell me I'm wrong, I really have. I don't want to be difficult or cause trouble for anyone. But it just feels so real to me. I hope that makes sense? I'm sorry if I'm sounding a bit repetitive, I just want to be sure I'm giving you the right answer for your notes. Did I do okay explaining that?
